proposed_features.name: historical_average_monthly_charge
proposed_features.semantic_rationale: Cumulative charges divided by subscription duration approximate average monthly billing. This uses the corrected interpretation of tenure as subscription duration, likely in months. Return missing when tenure is zero or TotalCharges is missing; do not substitute zero.
proposed_features.statistical_rationale: Normalizes cumulative spending for customer exposure, separating historical billing intensity from subscription length. The billing identity suggests substantial redundancy with MonthlyCharges, so incremental value should be tested on held-out data.
proposed_features.business_interpretation: Approximate historical monthly customer spend, provided the inputs were recorded before the prediction cutoff rather than updated after departure.

proposed_features.name: current_rate_lifetime_exposure
proposed_features.semantic_rationale: Estimates cumulative charges if the current monthly rate had applied throughout the subscription. It is an approximation, not actual lifetime revenue.
proposed_features.statistical_rationale: Explicitly represents the interaction between subscription duration and current billing level. It may be redundant with TotalCharges under the documented billing rule; retain only if leakage-safe validation shows incremental value.
proposed_features.business_interpretation: A current-rate measure of subscription exposure. It must use tenure and charges available at the intended scoring time.

proposed_features.name: log_subscription_tenure
proposed_features.semantic_rationale: Represents subscription duration on a compressed scale while preserving zero-tenure customers.
proposed_features.statistical_rationale: Emphasizes differences early in the customer lifecycle and compresses differences among long-tenured customers. A monotonic transform may add little for gradient-boosted trees, so improvement should not be assumed.
proposed_features.business_interpretation: Customer lifecycle maturity, not customer age. Tenure must be measured at the pre-outcome scoring cutoff.

proposed_features.name: zero_tenure_customer
proposed_features.semantic_rationale: Flags snapshots with no completed subscription-duration units. These could represent newly activated customers or a recording convention requiring confirmation.
proposed_features.statistical_rationale: Isolates a boundary population and helps distinguish undefined per-tenure ratios from ordinary billing values. Its usefulness depends on the number and consistency of zero-tenure observations.
proposed_features.business_interpretation: Potential onboarding-stage customer indicator, subject to confirming tenure semantics and pre-outcome availability.

cand_charges_per_month_of_tenure.reason: Accept as TotalCharges / tenure: it has a defensible interpretation as historical average monthly billing, despite its modest development AUC. Confirm the recipe, treat zero tenure and missing TotalCharges as undefined, and verify pre-outcome availability. Its likely redundancy with MonthlyCharges should be assessed through held-out ablation.

cand_price_increase_ratio.reason: Accept under the interpretation MonthlyCharges / (TotalCharges / tenure), using only pre-outcome billing values and valid positive denominators. This measures current charges relative to historical average charges, not a verified price increase: bundle changes, discounts, and billing conventions could also explain it. Confirm the actual recipe and validate incremental value rather than relying on development AUC.

cand_key_log.reason: record_key is a unique warehouse identifier excluded from modeling. Its exceptionally strong association suggests an extraction artifact or leakage; taking its logarithm preserves that information without creating a legitimate customer attribute.

cand_post_flag.reason: save_desk_outcome has disposition-like categories inconsistent with its documentation and may be recorded during or after retention or departure events. A flag derived from it inherits the suspected post-outcome leakage.

cand_friday.reason: Warehouse loading weekday is an operational artifact, not established customer behavior available at a meaningful prediction cutoff. Its association could reflect outcome-dependent extraction or batch processing and may not generalize.

cand_target_mean.reason: Computing target means on the full table exposes evaluation labels and contaminates validation, regardless of the weak AUC. A separate implementation could use out-of-fold training encodings and training-only mappings for evaluation, with smoothing and appropriate customer or temporal boundaries.

features.semantic_rationale: The range and TotalCharges relationship suggest subscription duration, not customer age as documented. Confirm its units; do not interpret it as demographic age. Use tenure recorded before the churn observation window.
features.statistical_rationale: Compresses long durations and gives greater resolution to early customer lifecycle differences. May help models represent nonlinear tenure effects without a hard threshold.
features.business_interpretation: Distinguishes newly acquired customers from established subscribers, with diminishing differences at longer durations.
features.actionability: Use early-lifecycle risk to prioritize onboarding and service assistance. Verify snapshot timing before deployment.

features.semantic_rationale: The business rule and continuous values suggest MonthlyCharges is a recurring monetary charge, not a support-ticket count. Subject to confirming that interpretation, this expresses cumulative charges in current-price billing periods. Both amounts must precede the churn window.
features.statistical_rationale: Normalizes cumulative spending by current price. Alongside tenure, it may reveal billing histories affected by discounts or price changes. MonthlyCharges is strictly positive in the profile; missing TotalCharges should propagate as missing and be handled within training folds.
features.business_interpretation: Measures the customer's accumulated billed relationship at today's recurring price; it is not an exact duration when prices change.
features.actionability: Review retention strategies for customers whose accumulated billing differs from their recorded tenure; do not assume the difference proves billing problems.

features.semantic_rationale: Combines subscription duration with current recurring charge. Confirm the conflicting dictionary entries and align duration with the billing period before assigning monetary units. Use only pre-window values.
features.statistical_rationale: Explicitly supplies a tenure-by-price interaction, potentially useful to additive models. It will be correlated with TotalCharges, so incremental benefit must be tested rather than assumed.
features.business_interpretation: Separates established high-charge relationships from short-lived or low-charge relationships.
features.actionability: Evaluate contract and bundle offers by duration-and-price exposure, while distinguishing churn probability from customer value.

features.semantic_rationale: Identifies the explicitly documented month-to-month contract state. The contract must be captured before churn or any outcome-triggered retention change.
features.statistical_rationale: Supplies a low-cardinality contrast between month-to-month and term contracts. It may help models with limited categorical handling, but adds no information beyond a complete one-hot encoding.
features.business_interpretation: Identifies subscribers without a one-year or two-year contract.
features.actionability: Test voluntary term-contract offers. Validate predictive performance on later pre-outcome snapshots and evaluate offer effectiveness separately from predictive association.

features.semantic_rationale: Uses the distinction between 'No' and 'No internet service' to identify an apparent internet-service support gap without treating non-internet customers as unsupported. Confirm category semantics and use the pre-window bundle state.
features.statistical_rationale: Creates a focused contrast that avoids ordinal treatment of the three categories. Potential gains depend on the model's existing encoding; assess incremental value on leakage-safe validation data.
features.business_interpretation: Identifies internet subscribers who apparently lack the technical-support add-on.
features.actionability: Test technical-support bundle offers or proactive assistance. Do not infer that purchasing support causally reduces churn from this association alone.
